children: LUCID USA, INC. IS RECALLING 27,185 U.S. VEHICLES - NHTSA

LUCID USA, INC. IS RECALLING SOME U.S. VEHICLES AS AN OVERHEATED CIRCUIT INCREASES THE RISK OF A FIRE. A LOSS OF THE CENTER BRAKE LIGHT OR FRONT LIGHTS CAN ALSO DECREASE VISIBILITY, INCREASING THE RISK OF A CRASH.- NHTSA
